name: Ephratah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness

points: The sons of Judah and the families that came from them are set down, including the line of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Bethlehem.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 4: The Families of Judah and Simeon
